title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt regression metrics into CI and add gating hook
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add CI hook to evaluate per-prompt regressions during PRs. New gating prevents merges that degrade prompt-set quality beyond configured thresholds. Backwards-compatible; disabled by default for small repos.
description: Motivation: several recent incidents were traced to small prompt-set regressions that slipped through unit tests. This PR integrates the eval-harness per-prompt metrics into the GitHub CI pipeline and adds a configurable gating hook that fails builds when a prompt-set's quality drops beyond tolerances. The change includes: 1) a lightweight CI runner step that downloads the reported eval artifacts, 2) a scoring comparator which applies per-prompt thresholds and aggregated quality delta checks, 3) a failure-mode that posts a detailed comment with failing prompts and links to the eval dashboard, and 4) feature flags to opt-in per-repo/route. Checklist: - [x] Implement metric comparator and gating logic - [x] Add CI workflow step and secrets handling - [x] Post actionable PR comment on failures - [x] Tests for comparator and integration - [x] Docs/README update for repo owners - [x] Performance: ensure runner completes within CI timeout (~15m) For rollout we will enable the gate for redwood/* repos under a staged rollout with monitoring. Related: ENG-4281 (prompt quality gating), SUP-1023 (customer incident postmortem).

review_comments: Diego Morales: Left a few suggestions on threshold defaults - current 5% absolute delta may be noisy for low-volume prompts. Can we add a relative-delta mode?
Ava Chen: Responded that comparator supports both absolute and relative thresholds; added config examples to docs. Updated tests to cover relative mode.
Priya Nair: Asked about CI runtime and cache behavior - ran the workflow in a fork and saw 12m runtime on medium dataset. Please add a timeout guard and show expected costs.
Ava Chen: Added explicit timeout (14m) and a cache step for artifact downloads to reduce network time. Included runtime numbers in the PR description.
Liam O'Connor: Requested the PR comment to include links to the dashboard and the failing prompt IDs - added in latest commit.
Diego Morales: Approves after minor nits fixed. Priya gave final approval as well.

notes_for_qa: To test locally: run tests/test_per_prompt_comparator.py, then run 'make local-eval' to simulate CI by pointing to a saved eval artifact. See docs/eval-harness/ci_integration.md for example artifact format.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy failures on low-volume prompts could block merges. Mitigation: feature flag off by default, conservative default thresholds, relative-delta option and manual override labels to bypass gate. We'll monitor false-positive rate for 2 weeks and iterate.
